1//! Ported from <https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/src/core/calculate_md5.js>.
2
3use alloc::vec::Vec;
4
5const SHIFT_AMOUNTS: [u32; 64] = [
6    7, 12, 17, 22, 7, 12, 17, 22, 7, 12, 17, 22, 7, 12, 17, 22, 5, 9, 14, 20, 5, 9, 14, 20, 5, 9, 14, 20, 5, 9, 14, 20, 4, 11, 16, 23, 4, 11, 16, 23,
7    4, 11, 16, 23, 4, 11, 16, 23, 6, 10, 15, 21, 6, 10, 15, 21, 6, 10, 15, 21, 6, 10, 15, 21,
8];
9
10const CONSTANTS: [u32; 64] = [
11    0xd76aa478, 0xe8c7b756, 0x242070db, 0xc1bdceee, 0xf57c0faf, 0x4787c62a, 0xa8304613, 0xfd469501, 0x698098d8, 0x8b44f7af, 0xffff5bb1, 0x895cd7be,
12    0x6b901122, 0xfd987193, 0xa679438e, 0x49b40821, 0xf61e2562, 0xc040b340, 0x265e5a51, 0xe9b6c7aa, 0xd62f105d, 0x02441453, 0xd8a1e681, 0xe7d3fbc8,
13    0x21e1cde6, 0xc33707d6, 0xf4d50d87, 0x455a14ed, 0xa9e3e905, 0xfcefa3f8, 0x676f02d9, 0x8d2a4c8a, 0xfffa3942, 0x8771f681, 0x6d9d6122, 0xfde5380c,
14    0xa4beea44, 0x4bdecfa9, 0xf6bb4b60, 0xbebfbc70, 0x289b7ec6, 0xeaa127fa, 0xd4ef3085, 0x04881d05, 0xd9d4d039, 0xe6db99e5, 0x1fa27cf8, 0xc4ac5665,
15    0xf4292244, 0x432aff97, 0xab9423a7, 0xfc93a039, 0x655b59c3, 0x8f0ccc92, 0xffeff47d, 0x85845dd1, 0x6fa87e4f, 0xfe2ce6e0, 0xa3014314, 0x4e0811a1,
16    0xf7537e82, 0xbd3af235, 0x2ad7d2bb, 0xeb86d391,
17];
18
19pub(crate) fn calculate(data: &[u8]) -> [u8; 16] {
20    let mut state = [0x67452301_u32, 0xefcdab89_u32, 0x98badcfe_u32, 0x10325476_u32];
21
22    let original_len = data.len();
23    let mut message = data.to_vec();
24    message.push(0x80);
25
26    while (message.len() % 64) != 56 {
27        message.push(0);
28    }
29
30    message.extend_from_slice(&(original_len as u64 * 8).to_le_bytes());
31
32    for chunk in message.chunks_exact(64) {
33        let words: Vec<u32> = chunk.chunks_exact(4).map(|bytes| u32::from_le_bytes(bytes.try_into().unwrap())).collect();
34
35        let mut working_vars = state;
36
37        for i in 0..64 {
38            let (f, g) = match i {
39                0..=15 => ((working_vars[1] & working_vars[2]) | (!working_vars[1] & working_vars[3]), i),
40                16..=31 => ((working_vars[3] & working_vars[1]) | (!working_vars[3] & working_vars[2]), (5 * i + 1) % 16),
41                32..=47 => (working_vars[1] ^ working_vars[2] ^ working_vars[3], (3 * i + 5) % 16),
42                48..=63 => (working_vars[2] ^ (working_vars[1] | !working_vars[3]), (7 * i) % 16),
43                _ => unreachable!(),
44            };
45
46            let temp = working_vars[3];
47            working_vars[3] = working_vars[2];
48            working_vars[2] = working_vars[1];
49            working_vars[1] = working_vars[1]
50                .wrapping_add((working_vars[0].wrapping_add(f).wrapping_add(CONSTANTS[i]).wrapping_add(words[g])).rotate_left(SHIFT_AMOUNTS[i]));
51            working_vars[0] = temp;
52        }
53
54        for (state_val, working_val) in state.iter_mut().zip(working_vars.iter()) {
55            *state_val = state_val.wrapping_add(*working_val);
56        }
57    }
58
59    let mut result = [0_u8; 16];
60    for (i, &word) in state.iter().enumerate() {
61        result[i * 4..(i + 1) * 4].copy_from_slice(&word.to_le_bytes());
62    }
63    result
64}
65
66#[cfg(any())]
67mod tests {
68    use super::*;
69
70    fn md5_test(data: &[u8]) {
71        let our_result = calculate(data);
72
73        let external_result = md5::compute(data);
74
75        assert_eq!(our_result, external_result.as_slice(), "MD5 calculation should match external md5 crate for input: {data:?}");
76    }
77
78    #[cfg(any())]
79    fn correctness() {
80        md5_test(b"Hello, World!");
81        md5_test(b"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog");
82        md5_test(b"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz");
83    }
84}
